description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for verifying CORS compliance of the device registry management API in the Eclipse Hono project. It tests various HTTP preflight OPTIONS requests for different API endpoints and methods, ensuring that proper CORS headers are returned.

classes.name: CorsIT
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class verifying CORS preflight responses for the device registry API.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up HTTP client before running tests.

methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for adding tenant data via POST.

methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for updating tenant data via PUT.

methods.name: testCorsPreflightRequestForGettingTenant
methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for retrieving tenant data via GET.

methods.name: testCorsPreflightRequestForDeletingTenant
methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for deleting tenant data via DELETE.

methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for retrieving device data via GET.

methods.name: testCorsPreflightRequestForDeletingDevice
methods.description: Tests CORS preflight response for deleting device data via DELETE.
